y-m-52-04.title: Uma singayazi k, ihlangana kangaki ne-x-axis?
y-m-52-04.goal: Zwakalisa ukuthi isahlulelo mayelana nenani lamaphoyinti okuhlangana komsebenzi we-quadratic ne-x-axis sincipha kanjani njengoba ulwazi lwanda, bese usho wonke amacala angenzeka ngisho noma elinye inani lingaziwa.
y-m-52-04.material: Kukhona i-parabola y = x² − 4x + k (k i-constant). Ulwazi mayelana no-k lwembulwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi. Njalo, khetha lokho ongakusho ngenani lamaphoyinti lapho le parabola ihlangana khona ne-x-axis (bala iphoyinti lapho ithinta nje njengo-1 iphoyinti).
y-m-52-04.thinking.0: Ukucabangela wonke amacala angenzeka uma ulwazi lubuthaka
y-m-52-04.thinking.1: Ukunciphisa noma ukushintsha isahlulelo ngolwazi olusha
y-m-52-04.prereq.1: Amagrafu emisebenzi ye-quadratic (i-vertex, ivulekile iye phezulu), nobudlelwano phakathi kwezimpande zangempela zesibalo se-quadratic namaphoyinti lapho igrafu ihlangana khona ne-x-axis
y-m-52-04.s.s1.hint.0: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, chaza ngamazwi lapho i-vertex ye-parabola ikhona (ngaphezulu noma ngaphansi kwe-x-axis).
y-m-52-04.s.s1.hint.1: Faka izinombolo eziphelele ezincane ezimbalwa esikhundleni sika-k bese uhlela inani lamaphoyinti okuhlangana ethebuleni.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Awuyazi k, kodwa wazi kuphela ukuthi k inhle (k>0).
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yini esingayisho ngenani lamaphoyinti lapho le parabola ihlangana khona ne-x-axis?
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Njengoba y=(x−2)²+k−4, i-vertex ngu-(2, k−4). Uma 0<k<4 i-vertex iphansi kwe-x-axis, ngakho kunamaphoyinti angu-2; uma k=4 ithinta i-x-axis, ngakho iphoyinti o-1; uma k>4 iphezulu kwe-x-axis, ngakho amaphoyinti angu-0. Uma kunenani elingaziwa, kumele ucabangele wonke amacala angenzeka.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Njengoba k inhle, i-vertex iphezulu kwe-x-axis, ngakho njalo kunamaphoyinti okuhlangana angu-0
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Bhala ukuqondanisa kwe-y kwe-vertex ngqo ngokuka-k. 'k inhle' akufani no-'ukuqondanisa kwe-y kwe-vertex kuhle.'
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: I-parabola evulekile iye phezulu ihlala inamaphoyinti angu-2
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ngisho noma ivulekile iye phezulu, uma i-parabola ntanta ngokuphelele ngaphezulu kwe-x-axis, ayihlangani nayo. Cabanga ngendawo ye-vertex.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kuye ngenani lika-k, amaphoyinti angu-0, 1, nangu-2 wonke ayenzeka
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Lesi yisahlulelo esicabangela amacala angenzeka ngokuzwakalisa ukuqondanisa kwe-y kwe-vertex kunyakaza phezulu naphansi no-k.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Kungenzeka u-0 noma u-2 kuphela, futhi akukho k enika u-1 ngqo
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Iphoyinti o-1 lenzeka uma i-vertex ilele ku-x-axis. Hlola ukuthi k enjalo ingaphakathi kwezinombolo ezinhle yini.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Iqiniso elisha: ukuqondanisa kwe-y kwe-vertex yale parabola kungu-0 noma ngaphansi.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kuhlanganiswe nolwazi lokuthi k>0, yini esingayisho ngenani lamaphoyinti okuhlangana?
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Uma k−4≤0 no-k>0, khona-ke 0<k≤4. Uma 0<k<4, kunamaphoyinti amabili ahlukile, futhi uma k=4, ithinta endaweni eyodwa. Ngakho amaphoyinti angu-0 awenzeki, kodwa asikazi ukuthi ngu-1 noma 2. Isahlulelo sokuqala ('wonke ayenzeka') besingalungile; njengoba ulwazi lwanda, amacala angenzeka anciphile.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ngu-1 noma 2 kuye ngokuthi k ngu-4 yini, futhi ihlangana okungenani endaweni eyodwa
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Lesi yisahlulelo esihlukanisa icala lapho ukuqondanisa kwe-y kwe-vertex kungu-0 nelicala lapho kungaphansi kuka-0.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Kungakhathaliseki indawo ye-vertex, amaphoyinti angu-0, 1, nangu-2 asenzeka wonke
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Bhala futhi ukuthi umbandela wokuthi ukuqondanisa kwe-y k−4 kwe-vertex kungu-0 noma ngaphansi kuncipha kanjani ububanzi bika-k obungenzeka.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Uma singazi ukuthi k ngu-4 ngqo yini, asikwazi ukunquma ukuthi ngu-1 noma 2, kodwa akuyona u-0
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Lesi yisahlulelo esihlukanisa lokho okungenakunqunywa nalokho okungakunqunywa.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Njengoba i-vertex iphansi kwe-x-axis, ihlala inqunywa ibe ngu-2
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Hlola ukuthi icala lapho ukuqondanisa kwe-y kwe-vertex kungu-0 ngqo kufakiwe yini embandelweni.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Ufunda futhi ukuthi k iyinombolo ephelele. (inombolo ephelele k ene-0<k≤4)
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mangaki amanani ka-k enza ukuqondanisa kwe-x kwawo wonke amaphoyinti lapho ihlangana khona ne-x-axis kube yizinombolo eziphelele?
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Uma k=1, x=2±√3, futhi uma k=2, x=2±√2, okungezona izinombolo eziphelele. Uma k=3, x=1, 3, futhi uma k=4, x=2 (iphoyinti lokuthinta), konke okuyizinombolo eziphelele, ngakho impendulo ngu-2. Kuye ngokuthi icala lokuthinta libalwa njengokuhlangana yini, impendulo ingafundwa njengo-1, ngakho ekuqaleni savumelana 'sibale njengephoyinti o-1 lokuhlangana.'
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Icala lokuthinta (iphoyinti o-1 lokuhlangana) nalo liyiphoyinti lokuhlangana. Bheka emuva ukuthi uhlolile yini ukuthi ukuqondanisa kwe-x kuleso simo kuyinombolo ephelele.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Lesi yisahlulelo esihambisana nomphumela wokufaka amanani amane ka-k ngokulandelana nokuthola ukuqondanisa kwe-x kwamaphoyinti okuhlangana.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Thola ngqo ukuqondanisa kwe-x kwamaphoyinti okuhlangana kwa-k=1 no-2.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Thola ngqo ukuqondanisa kwe-x kwamaphoyinti lapho ihlangana khona ne-x-axis uma k=1 bese uhlola ukuthi ayizinombolo eziphelele yini.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni wahlulela 'wonke ayenzeka,' kodwa njengoba ulwazi lwanda kwancipha kwaba ngu-'akuyona u-0' no-'u-2 kuphela njengomkhethwa'. Isahlulelo sakho sishintsha kanjani ngokuhlukile ekutheni isahlulelo sakho sokuqala sasingalungile? Uma ubunqume inombolo eyodwa ngolwazi oluncane kakhulu, ubuyophutha kuphi?
y-m-52-04.s.s2.prompt: Kulokhu, akukho mbandela wokuthi k inhle; kuphela ukuthi k iyinombolo ephelele. Thola amanani ama-3 ahlukene ka-k lapho i-parabola ihlangana khona ne-x-axis emaphoyinteni amabili ahlukile futhi ibanga phakathi kwalawo maphoyinti amabili liyinombolo ephelele.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.hint.0: Misa k eyodwa bese uthola ukuqondanisa kwe-x kwamaphoyinti amabili okuhlangana.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ibanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili okuhlangana ngokuka-k, bese ubheka ukuthi k kumele ibe nesimo esinjani ukuze leli nani libe yinombolo ephelele.

y-m-52-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Ibanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili okuhlangana liyinombolo ephelele.

y-m-52-04.s.s2.explain: Ukuqondanisa kwe-x kwamaphoyinti amabili okuhlangana ngu-2±√(4−k), ngakho ibanga ngu-2√(4−k). Uma 4−k isikwele esiphelele (1, 4, 9, 16, ...), ibanga liyinombolo ephelele, futhi k = 3, 0, −5, −12, −21, ...

y-m-52-01.title: Umphumela uyafana uma sishintshanisa ukulandelana?
y-m-52-01.goal: Funda ukuthi ukuthola umphumela ofanayo ngokufakwayo okukodwa akubufakazi be-'njalo kufana,' bese uphikisa isitatimende ngokuthola okufakwayo lapho ukulandelana kushintsha umphumela khona.
y-m-52-01.material:
Kunemishini emibili yokubala. Umshini f uphindaphinda okufakwayo kabili bese wengeza u-1 (f(x)=2x+1), futhi umshini g wenza okufakwayo kube yisikwele (g(x)=x²). Okufakwayo kungaba yinoma iyiphi inombolo yangempela.
Uma uxhuma 'f bese g,' umphumela ngu-g(f(x)); uma uxhuma 'g bese f,' umphumela ngu-f(g(x)). UMinseo uthe, "Kunoma yimiphi imishini emibili, umphumela uyafana noma ushintshanisa ukulandelana. Kusebenza nasemishinini yethu uma ngifaka u-0. f bese g: f(0)=1, g(1)=1. g bese f: g(0)=0, f(0)=1."

y-m-52-01.thinking.2: Hlukanisa okufakwayo okukhethekile lapho izibalo ezimbili ziba lingana ngenhlanhla

y-m-52-01.s.s1.hint.1: Funa ethebuleni ngisho nesiseli esisodwa lapho imiphumela emibili ehlukile.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.o.a: Ziyafana ku-0, kodwa asazi ukuthi ziyafana yini kwamanye amanani okufakwayo. Kufanele sishintshe okufakwayo futhi sibale ngokwehlukana.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.r.a: Lesi sinqumo siyazi ukuthi umphumela wokufakwayo okukodwa usitshela kuphela ngalokho okufakwayo, futhi sizama ukukhetha okufakwayo okungaphezulu ukuhlola.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.o.b: Ukuxuba kuyahambisana njengokuphindaphinda, ngakho kuyafana noma ukulandelana kushintshiwe, futhi ukuba lingana ku-0 ubufakazi
y-m-52-01.s.s1.r.b: Ngokungafani nokuphindaphinda, ukushintsha ukulandelana kokuxuba kuvame ukushintsha umphumela. Hlola ukuthi ukulingana ku-0 kusebenza yini njengobufakazi, nokuthi ziyafana nakwamanye amanani okufakwayo yini.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.o.c: Uma sifaka okunye okufakwayo okumbalwa futhi konke kuphuma kufana, khona-ke singaphetha ngokuthi ziyafana njalo.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.r.c: Noma uhlola okunye okufakwayo okumbalwa, awukahloli zonke izinombolo zangempela. Ukuphetha ngokuthi ziyafana kufanele uqhathanise izibalo, futhi ukuhluka kungakhonjiswa ngesibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.o.d: Imiphumela yokuqala yokubala yezindlela ezimbili ihlukile, f(0)=1 no-g(0)=0, ngakho imiphumela yokugcina nayo ihlala ihlukile.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.r.d: Noma imiphumela yesinyathelo sokuqala ihlukile, imiphumela yokugcina ingafana. Ku-0, imiphumela yokugcina yezindlela zombili ibingu-1.

y-m-52-01.s.s2.prompt: Thola okufakwayo okungu-3 okuhlukile x okuphula isitatimende sikaMinseo. (Imiphumela emibili g(f(x)) no-f(g(x)) kufanele ihluke. Ungasebenzisa noma yiyiphi inombolo yangempela x.)

Umehluko wezibalo ezimbili ngu-2x²+4x=2x(x+2), ngakho okufakwayo kuphela lapho zilingana khona ngu-x=0 no-x=-2; wonke amanye amanani okufakwayo ayizibonelo eziphikisayo.

y-m-52-02.title: Amagrafu amabili ahlangana kuphi?
y-m-52-02.goal: Phikisa, ngesibonelo esiphikisayo, ukwenza okujwayelekile okungalungile kweqiniso lokuthi 'igrafu yomsebenzi ophambene ihambisana ngokuhlangene ku-y=x' kusho 'amaphoyinti okuwelana nawo ase-y=x,' bese usho umbandela lapho izibonelo eziphikisayo zenzeka khona.
y-m-52-02.material:
Uma umsebenzi f unomsebenzi ophambene f⁻¹, amagrafu amabili ahambisana ngokuhlangene emugqeni y=x. UJiho uthe, "Ngakho amaphoyinti lapho amagrafu e-f ne-f⁻¹ ahlangana khona ahlala emugqeni y=x. Isibonelo, uma f(x)=2x−3, khona-ke f⁻¹(x)=(x+3)/2 futhi amagrafu amabili ahlangana ku-(3,3), ngakho kulungile. f(x)=x³ nayo ihlangana ku-(0,0), (1,1), no-(−1,−1)."
(Cabanga kuphela ngemisebenzi emiswe kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela x. Ake siwubize umugqa y=x ngokuthi 'i-axis yokuhambisana'.)

y-m-52-02.s.s1.r.a: Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ubhekile ukuthi yiziphi izici izibonelo ezihloliwe ezabelana ngazo futhi wangabaza amacala angaphandle kwazo.
y-m-52-02.s.s1.o.b: Sihlolile izinhlobo ezimbili ezahlukile, umsebenzi olayini nomsebenzi wekhyubhu, ngakho sesivele sihlole wonke amacala
y-m-52-02.s.s1.r.b: Noma izinhlobo zemisebenzi (isimo sesibalo) zihlukile, amagrafu azo angabelana ngesici esifanayo ngesimo. Qhathanisa izimo zamagrafu amabili.
y-m-52-02.s.s1.o.c: Njengoba amagrafu ehambisana ngokuhlangene, sekuvele kufakazelwe ukuthi amaphoyinti okuwelana kufanele abe ku-axis yokuhambisana.
y-m-52-02.s.s1.r.c: Ukusho ukuthi amaphoyinti okuwelana akuphi, kufanele ucabangele ngokwehlukana ukuthi asemgqeni we-axis yokuhambisana yini noma cha. Cabanga ukuthi iqiniso lokuhambisana lunquma nendawo yamaphoyinti okuwelana yini.
y-m-52-02.s.s1.o.d: Kunezibonelo ezi-2, ngakho singasho ngokwenzeka ukuthi kuhlala kubamba. Akukho sidingo sokuhlola okwengeziwe.

y-m-52-02.s.s2.hint.1: Shintsha a ibe ngu--2, -1, 1/2, 2, njalonjalo, bese uhlola ukuthi amanani amabili aba lingana ephoyinteni elifanayo yini.
y-m-52-02.s.s2.hint.2: Uma uqoqa izibonelo zakho ezintathu, bheka ukuthi a noma b ihlala inani elifanayo yini.

y-m-52-03.title: Ama-asymptote nokuvimbela kwabhalwa uHarin: singamethemba kangakanani?

y-m-52-03.goal: Thola umugqa ophutha esixazululweni, hlela ukuthi leli phutha lithinta ini phakathi kwama-asymptote, i-intercept nendawo yegrafu nokuthi alithinti ini, bese uphakamisa indlela yokuhlola ephathelene nokuthi iphutha litholakale ngokwakho.
y-m-52-03.material: Ukufunda ngegrafu yomsebenzi we-rational y=(2x+1)/(x−1), uHarin uxazulule njengaphansi. Wabhala ukuthi ama-asymptote angu-x=1 no-y=2, futhi wathola nephoyinti lapho le grafu ihlangana khona ne-y-axis. (Cabanga ngezinombolo zangempela x ezine-x≠1.)

y-m-52-06.title: Igophe nelayini bahlangana kangaki?
y-m-52-06.topic: Inani lokuhlangana kwegrafu yomsebenzi ongeyona i-rational nelayini
y-m-52-06.goal: Funda ukuthi inani lokuhlangana komsebenzi ongeyona i-rational nelayini alikwazi ukunqunywa nge-discriminant yesibalo se-quadratic kuphela, bese uthola wena ububanzi bika-k lapho kunokuhlangana okungu-2 ngqo ngokucabangela isifunda nobubanzi bamanani (x+k−1≥0).
y-m-52-06.material:
Igrafu yomsebenzi ongeyona i-rational y = √(x+2) + 1 yigophe eliqala ephoyintini (−2, 1) futhi likhuphukela ngakwesokudla esiphezulu, lithambile kancane kancane (x ≥ −2). Sifuna ukuthola inani lokuhlangana nelayini y = x + k.
UDaeun uxazulule kanje. “Misa izisho ezimbili zilingane ukuthola √(x+2) = x + k − 1, bese usikwela izinhlangothi zombili ukuthola x² + (2k−3)x + (k−1)² − 2 = 0. I-discriminant yalesi sibalo se-quadratic ngu-13 − 4k, ngakho uma k < 13/4 kunezimpande ezimbili zangempela ezihlukile, okusho ukuhlangana okubili.”
